name: Beta Feedback
author: modpunk (omarchy.fans)
description: Beta program for Omarchy plugins: end users opt in, get a bug button inside enrolled plugins, and file reports carrying the last 10 clicks, a panel-only screenshot they annotate, and version info. A troubleshooting recording captures the focused screen with an on-screen key display and a timestamped log of key presses (typed text hidden by default) and desktop events, for bugs in plugins or the desktop itself. Reports become GitHub issues on the plugin's repo; authors triage them, let an agent fix them on a staging branch, and testers get an update-ready notification.

barWidget.description: Bug chip: troubleshooting recordings, betas you can join, your enrollments and reports, and update-now buttons when a fix is ready.
